## 3. Academic Structure & Class Details
### Playgroup (Ages 1.8 – 2.5 Years)
- Focus: Sensory development, fine and gross motor coordination, social habit formation, interactive free play, emotional security
- Environment: Child-proofed activity corners, soft toys, sensory bins, musical circle time

### Nursery (Ages 2.5 – 3.5 Years)
- Focus: Foundational phonics, basic color and shape recognition, vocabulary building, creative coloring, structured curiosity
- Learning Methodology: Play-way and Montessori-integrated exploration

### Junior Kindergarten / Jr. KG (Ages 3.5 – 4.5 Years)
- Focus: Pre-writing readiness, number comprehension (1-50), phonics blends, early environmental studies, public speaking confidence
- Learning Methodology: Hands-on experiential learning, STEM toy integration

### Senior Kindergarten / Sr. KG (Ages 4.5 – 5.5 Years)
- Focus: Independent reading, sentence construction, foundational mathematical operations, formal school transition preparation
- Learning Methodology: Cognitive challenge puzzles, guided library reading, collaborative teamwork

### Primary, Middle & Secondary School (Grade 1 to Grade 10)
- Focus: Core academics (English, Mathematics, General Science, Social Studies, Hindi, Marathi, Computer Science), continuous assessment, Olympiad preparation, conceptual understanding
- Co-curricular: Visual arts, performing arts, yoga, physical education, laboratory practicals

### Senior Secondary School (Grade 11 & Grade 12)
- Focus: Specialized streams (Science, Commerce) with focused competitive exam orientation, career counseling, computer applications

## 4. Campus Infrastructure & Safety Standards
- Location Safety: Situated inside the gated residential township of Neptune Swarajya, isolated from heavy highway traffic
- Video Surveillance: Complete CCTV camera coverage of all classrooms, corridors, entrances, and play grounds
- Child Hygiene: Dedicated female caretakers (didis / maushis), child-height ergonomic washrooms, filtered UV-purified drinking water
- First Aid & Health: Immediate emergency first-aid kit, on-call medical practitioners, regular health check-up drives
- Digital Learning: Smart interactive panels, audio-visual educational aids, dedicated computer lab
